verdict.rationale: Snowflake's own developer docs list first-party JDBC and ODBC drivers (plus Python, Go, Node.js), which covers the standard-driver half of the story. The pack has no documented BI-tool integrations; the only related item is a generic line about 'applications and tools that you can use to access Snowflake'. missing for 10: documented named BI-tool integrations (e.g. partner connectors), in-depth driver connection docs, independent/hands-on corroboration of dashboards connecting without custom glue.

support.subject: As an analyst, standard drivers (JDBC/ODBC) and documented BI-tool integrations connect my dashboards without custom glue

citations.quote: Learn about the applications and tools that you can use to access Snowflake
